title: Handoff tracker + 1:1 prep (PM ↔ Eng Lead)
content:
Meeting: PM <-> Eng Lead 1:1 (30m)
When: 2026-03-12 10:30am PT
Attendees: Jordan (PM), Ravi (Eng Lead)
Location: Zoom / quick async notes here

Purpose / top goals for this sync:
- Quick status on Dedicated rollout (beta customers, perf numbers)
- Lock on console UX scope for rollout page and cost breakdowns
- Triage two blockers (KV cache regressions, autoscale flapping) and assign owners
- Align on near-term tradeoffs for latency vs cost (batching + quantization suggestions)

Context snippets to remind Ravi:
- Beta customer A reported 3 regressions post-deploy: p95 generation latency up ~22% on 8k tokens, tail tokens/timeouts increased. Ticket INF-1423 opened.
- Dedicated pool alpha: 2 customers onboarded, target SLA discussions next week. Current throughput metrics attached in PR #889.
- Console: design freeze end of month; need to decide whether to show per-route token cost vs aggregated estimate. Prod teams ask for token-level drilldown.

Notes to self (things I want to get clarity on):
- Risk: If we enable continuous batching by default for Dedicated, what happens to deterministic latency SLOs? Need a concrete degradation profile.
- Ask about KV cache eviction policy change in last runtime deploy — who owned that change and can we rollback?
- Can we offer a "preview quantization" flag in Dedicated so SREs can test cost/quality tradeoffs without full rollout?

Agenda (tight):
1) 5m - Quick wins and highlights (customer praise, metrics)
2) 10m - Dedicated rollout status + infra blockers (INF-1423)
3) 8m - Console decisions (cost drilldown, rollout page scope)
4) 5m - Action items and next 48h commitments

Customer / metrics snapshot to share quickly:
- Beta A: p50 120ms -> 140ms, p95 380ms -> 460ms after 2026-02-25 deploy
- Token cost estimate for sample workload: $0.00095/token (baseline) -> $0.00078/token (with quantized variant)
- Dedicated utilization for pool-3: 62% avg, spikes to 96% during peak batch windows

Key questions I need answered in the meeting:
- Is the KV cache eviction regression from the runtime change or from upstream model KVs? (short answer + owner)
- What's our rollback plan if a Dedicated customer reports SLA breaches? Do we have automated fallback to hosted variants?
- Console UX: do we show "per-route token cost" by default or behind an experimental toggle for early customers?

Proposed proposals (my suggestions to discuss):
- Roll back the eviction policy change immediately for pool-3 and run the A/B for two weeks to measure tail latency (proposal owner: Ravi).
- Add a "quantization preview" flag in Dedicated console for advanced customers; label clearly and keep analytics gated. Quick spike: 2 engineer-days.
- For console cost drilldown, ship aggregated cost + one-click expand to per-route breakdown (avoid clutter for first release).

Immediate risks / blockers (need action during or after meeting):
- Autoscale flapping on pool-3 causing request requeues — root cause unknown; assign SRE pair to reproduce and capture flamegraphs.
- INF-1423 needs priority; need someone from runtime on rotation for debug sessions this week.

Action items (clear, owner, due):
- Ravi: Triage INF-1423, confirm whether eviction change caused regression; report findings by 2026-03-15.
- Jordan: Draft customer communication template for Beta A if rollback is required; share by EOD 2026-03-12.
- Annie: Put together a minimal console mock for per-route cost drilldown (desktop only) by 2026-03-18.
- SRE (TBD): Capture flamegraphs for autoscale flapping and add to ticket; ETA 2026-03-14.

Follow-ups to schedule:
- Post-triage quick sync (15m) after Ravi findings — target 2026-03-16 if needed.
- Console decision review with design + legal for cost messaging (30m) week of 2026-03-22.

Open notes / ideas (brainstorm, leave messy):
- Could we expose a per-deployment "quality slider" in console: conservative (no quant), experimental (quant preview), aggressive (quant). Might reduce support burden by surfacing tradeoffs.
- Short term: add explicit metric for "tail token timeouts" to alerting rule (threshold: >1% requests hitting timeout in 5m window).
- Consider temporary rate-limiter on beta customers to protect Dedicated pools while we investigate.

Slack snippets to copy/paste if I need to prod the eng channel:
- "Heads up: pushing INF-1423 to priority 1. Ravi to lead triage; need runtime owner for debug session today. Ping if you can help capture traces."
- "Rolling back the KV eviction change temporarily for pool-3 unless we have a concrete fix by EOD Friday — will coordinate with on-call."

Personal reminders (1:1 style):
- Start with quick personal check-in (family, focus) — 1-2 min
- Keep the sync action-oriented; aim to leave with owners on the two blockers
- If Ravi is overloaded, ask which item I can escalate to product ops to unblock (customer comms, console mocks)

End of note.

-- Jordan
